video_title: Rachel Nichols 76ers Camp Takeaways // Knicks Contract Extensions | Rachel Nichols & Chris Mannix

quotes.speaker: Chris Mannix
quotes.summary_phrase: Knicks' decision to pause contract extensions for current players
quotes.excerpt: Knicks' curious decision to put the brakes on some of these contract extensions
quotes.quote: The Knicks made a curious decision to put the brakes on some of these contract extensions that they are currently dealing with right now.

quotes.speaker: Chris Mannix
quotes.summary_phrase: Nikola Jokic's impending max contract extension
quotes.excerpt: I think that max contract is coming his way. I think he's in no danger there.
quotes.quote: I think that max contract is coming his way. I think he's in no danger there.

quotes.speaker: Chris Mannix
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Duren's contract extension with the Detroit Pistons
quotes.excerpt: Jaylen Duren signing the lucrative five-year $200 million deal that the Pistons effectively had on the table
quotes.quote: The continuing developing story this week is the Jaylen Duren resigning with the Detroit Pistons. It was publicly at least a very acrimonious contract negotiation to the point where Duren clearly considered at least signing the one-year $9.6 million qualifying offer that would have allowed him to become an unrestricted free agent at the end of this season. Instead, he signs the lucrative five-year $200 million deal that the Pistons effectively had on the table for months. This was kind of where the Pistons settled on midway through the off-season, and they didn't really budge off that extension.

quotes.speaker: Rachel Nichols
quotes.summary_phrase: Pistons fans' reaction to Jaylen Duren's commitment
quotes.excerpt: I think they have to feel pretty good about it. He seemed pretty genuine in the stuff
quotes.quote: I think they have to feel pretty good about it. He seemed pretty genuine in the stuff that I saw. It felt as if he was talking about learning about contract negotiations and that he's smarter about the business now. Some of the emotion that we had reported that he had felt over the previous month, maybe he's let some of that go, and he signed the deal, and he's there now.

quotes.speaker: Rachel Nichols
quotes.summary_phrase: Pistons' need for better spacing and options next to Cade Cunningham
quotes.excerpt: They still have a spacing issue. They still need a better option next to Cade Cunningham
quotes.quote: I am much more concerned with this team about the fact that they still have a spacing issue. They still need a better option next to Cade Cunningham than I am about Jaylen Duren ruining anything with the fact that this contract dragged on so long.

quotes.speaker: Chris Mannix
quotes.summary_phrase: Tobias Harris's consistency for the Pistons
quotes.excerpt: I thought Tobias Harris was remarkably consistent for them over the last few years.
quotes.quote: I thought Tobias Harris was remarkably consistent for them over the last few years.

quotes.speaker: Chris Mannix
quotes.summary_phrase: Isaiah Joe and Aaron Wiggins as most improved players
quotes.excerpt: At the top of my list of potential most improved players are two guys you just let go.
quotes.quote: At the top of my list of potential most improved players are two guys you just let go: Isaiah Joe and Aaron Wiggins. That's a testament to the level of talent they have in Oklahoma City and player development, but I think Isaiah Joe can have, if he gets the minutes, a really productive year. He is an elite three-point shooter and they need spacing on that team.

quotes.speaker: Chris Mannix
quotes.summary_phrase: Knicks' potential decision to avoid contract extensions
quotes.excerpt: We've seen some reporting this week that the Knicks may just not extend anybody this off-season.
quotes.quote: We've seen some reporting this week that the Knicks may just not extend anybody this off-season. They've got a handful of guys that can be extended, and it doesn't sound like they're going to do that.

quotes.speaker: Chris Mannix
quotes.summary_phrase: Knicks' missed opportunity to re-sign Mitchell Robinson
quotes.excerpt: I would have liked to have seen them spend the money to spend to get Mitchell Robinson back.
quotes.quote: I would have liked to have seen them spend the money to spend to get Mitchell Robinson back, because Mitchell Robinson is like a lifelong Knick. He's a big part of not just what they do on the floor, but he's part of that locker room. Not spending on him to me was like, what are you doing here?

quotes.speaker: Chris Mannix
quotes.summary_phrase: Deuce McBride's role and contract status
quotes.excerpt: The one guy I'm actually more concerned with is Deuce McBride. He's an expiring deal.
quotes.quote: The one guy I'm actually more concerned with is Deuce McBride. He's an expiring deal, and he's a big part of their bench. If he has a great year, he is going to be way out of their price range. That's a guy I would want to work hard to get on a long-term deal that makes sense.

quotes.speaker: Chris Mannix
quotes.summary_phrase: Boston's value contract with Payton Pritchard
quotes.excerpt: It's like what Boston did with Payton Pritchard, which is now the greatest contract in the NBA.
quotes.quote: It's like what Boston did with Payton Pritchard, which is now the greatest contract in the NBA in terms of value for dollar. That's the kind of thing that the Knicks should be looking to deal with with Deuce McBride.

quotes.speaker: Chris Mannix
quotes.summary_phrase: V.J. Edgecombe's role on the Knicks
quotes.excerpt: V.J. Edgecombe was on like the ascendant and now he's like the fifth option on that team.
quotes.quote: V.J. Edgecombe was on like the ascendant and now he's like the fifth option on that team. So I think that's getting him his touches is probably a legitimate question or concern to have.

quotes.speaker: Chris Mannix
quotes.summary_phrase: Joel Embiid's role and health on the 76ers
quotes.excerpt: When Joel Embiid's out there, he's still the process. He's still the guy that has been there the longest.
quotes.quote: When Joel Embiid's out there, he's still the process. He's still the guy that has been there the longest. He's still three years removed from being named the MVP. So his body's broken down a lot since then, things have changed a lot since then, but what is Joel Embiid bracing for? What kind of role is he expecting with this group?

quotes.speaker: Chris Mannix
quotes.excerpt: Jaylen Brown knows how to fit into a particular situation. He knows how to be a 1A.
quotes.quote: Jaylen Brown knows how to fit into a particular situation. He knows how to be a 1A or a two, whatever it may be. That he wasn't in Boston, that he now is in Philadelphia. He obviously has a lot of confidence after what he did last season, but even though he didn't choose the 76ers, I think he's going to find a way to make it work.
